answer: Cross-sign every proof-of-personhood with three independent auditors and split the attestation so no single auditor sees the whole claim. Idle identities bleed standing each epoch, which prices parked accounts. A whisper of a cloned identity is enough to void the cross-signature. No zephyr of new registrations hides the gap, since only a signed relic of old work counts. Standing decays, so a farm has to keep working.
